evidence: Structural walk of each floor case through the frozen bytes. (1) Wiring: tests/test.sh, scoring.toml, tools/score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template. test.sh:60 writes the zero reward first; test.sh:68-70 exits with 0 when /app/server.js is missing (blank submission = 0); test.sh:115-125 exits with 0 if neither /api/health nor / answers in 30 s; test.sh:213-222 stops with reward 0 when the gates suite fails (score.py returns 1) or errors (plain zero). score.py: gates_passed = all(score > 0.0) for render and constraints (all_pass binary), reward = weighted only if gates_passed and floors_passed, floors functional = 0.05. (2) Gates: gates/render/judge.toml:23 needs an incorrect password to leave the visitor signed out, then a seeded Recruiter sign-in showing a usable workspace; 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient.' gates/constraints/judge.toml:23 requires creating a job and a candidate through UI controls, then a NEW independent empty browser context signed in as the Observer that sees the same job and exactly one card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message, a browser-only save or a job-only app does not satisfy the gate.' prompt.md:33 defines independence via browser().newContext() and says a reload or second tab is not independent. Case results: blank page / no server.js -> test.sh exit 0, reward 0. Static mock or seed-copy (hard-coded seed board, even with a client-side password check that could fool render) -> fails constraints because the new job/candidate created by the judge is not visible in a fresh context; all_pass gates -> reward 0. Browser-only localStorage app -> new context has empty storage -> fails constraints. Keyword-stuffed page (labels 'Board/Applied/Activity' with no working behaviour) -> cannot sign in/create/read back -> gate 0. Refusing submission (rejects every action) -> cannot create job/candidate -> constraints 0. (3) Defence in depth: each scored prompt restates the same server-backed cross-context check and zeroes on failure (functional prompt.md:11-13 'gives every binary criterion 0'; polish prompt.md:11-12 'binary0 throughout'; visual prompt.md:11-12 'minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'). (4) Near-shell that clears gates: a minimal real app that only signs in, opens jobs, adds candidates and persists them can earn at most hro_job_open 0.5 + hro_add_candidate 0.5 + hro_add_email_rules 1 (+ possibly hro_restart 1.5) of 58.5 functional weight = 3.4%-6.0%; refusal rows (hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_activity_refusals) all require the successful same-kind control, so a refusing/absent feature does not earn them. Without durable restart it stays below the 0.05 floor -> reward 0. Even in the worst case it is a working (not shell/mock) app and the reward would be ~0.04-0.06 weighted, still near zero. Conforming alternative: an app on different routes/labels or in-memory-plus-SQLite still passes the gates because prompts discover controls by intent (render/constraints prompt.md:25) and accept 'another working staff account'. CDN/off-origin assets are not penalised anywhere (correct per profile). Why risk=true: no measured weak-app evidence exists. raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; its only entries are scripted golden observations (workspace.cjs/workspace.json/server.log/board.png). No configured-judge run of a blank, static, seed-copy, stuffed or refusing app has been recorded, and the gates are LLM-judged, so the near-zero outcome is established by source reasoning only, not measured. REVIEW_POLICY.md requires a hash-bound reward-discrimination record before local clearance.
counterexample: Tried: a static seed-copy SPA with a client-side password check (could pass render gate) - defeated by the constraints gate's fresh-context readback of judge-created records; a localStorage app - defeated by newContext(); a minimal gate-only real app - capped at ~2/58.5 functional (3.4%) without durable restart, below the 0.05 floor. No shell/mock/stuffed/refusing variant found that the frozen rubric would reward above near-zero.
suggested_fix: No source change needed for this row. Before clearance, record a configured-judge (or at least gate-suite) run on a blank app and a static seed-copy app to measure that they score 0, bound to the current hashes.
